subject: Post-demo: Compliance intake & evidence ownership (security milestone)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.dev>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@clearwave.io>, Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@clearwave.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.dev>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.dev>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Compliance intake & evidence ownership (security milestone)

Hi Maya / Aaron —

Thanks again for today's demo and the candid discussion on your compliance requirements. As promised, here's a concise post-call recap and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone specific to the security review / SOC 2 evidence delivery so we can align owners and dates.

Summary (one-line): ClearWave to complete vendor security review; Redwood to produce SOC 2 evidence bundle and questionnaire responses. Target: make security milestone a gated MAP item before commercial sign-off.

Draft MAP milestone: Security review & SOC 2 package
- Objective: Provide ClearWave with our SOC 2 evidence package (controls matrix, policy docs, scoped system diagrams, sample logs, encryption/keys evidence) and complete vendor questionnaire.
- Redwood owner: Monica Patel — compile package, surface any gaps to engineering.
- Engineering owner: Karthik Iyer — export sample logs, confirm key management config and SSO metadata.
- ClearWave owner: Maya Patel / security@clearwave.io — validate artifacts and return any follow-up asks.
- Dependencies: access to a short vendor questionnaire (we can use yours or ours), a shared Drive for artifacts, and a test account for log samples if needed.
- Proposed due dates: package assembled by 2026-12-10, review feedback by 2026-12-14, MAP security gate closed by 2026-12-20 (final close contingent on acceptance criteria).

Attachments: redwood_compliance_intake_v1.pdf (MAP + milestone matrix), redwood-soc2-evidence-checklist-v1.xlsx (evidence index), redwood-map-draft.pdf (high-level timeline).

Asks / next steps:
1) Maya/Aaron: confirm whether you prefer to use your vendor questionnaire or ours (we attached ours for reference).
2) Monica/Karthik: confirm owners and feasibility of the 12/10 deliverable — highlight any items that will require more time.
3) Propose a short stakeholder sync (30 min) the week of 12/7 to walk the package and any open items — please share availability.

If this looks right I will update the MAP doc in the shared Drive and mark owners/dates as agreed.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.dev
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Maya Patel <m.patel@clearwave.io>

Cc: Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@clearwave.io>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Compliance intake & evidence ownership (security milestone)

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying questions from our security team: 

1) We can use either questionnaire; please send your vendor questionnaire (we'll start with that).
2) For the evidence package, we typically need:
   - System architecture diagram with data flow and scoped components (including any 3rd-party integrations)
   - Proof of encryption at rest and in transit; details on KMS/HSM usage and key rotation cadence
   - Sample audit/log exports (last 30 days) and retention policy
   - IAM/SAML SSO metadata and a list of admin users plus role descriptions

3) Two clarifications from our side: retention for token-level logs (how long are prefixes/KV cache logs kept?), and whether you redact PII in debug logs by default.

We can target 12/10 for an initial package but our security team will likely request follow-ups. We'll be able to run through the questionnaire and get back with specific asks by 12/14.

I'll loop in security@clearwave.io separately if we want them on the kick-off sync.

—Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Security Operations | ClearWave
m.patel@clearwave.io
--
Note: attaching our vendor checklist in case it's helpful (CW-vendor-checklist.pdf)

Thanks Maya — looping Karthik for the infra specifics. Quick internal commitments from our side so we can update the MAP and confirm dates:

- Controls matrix (crosswalk to SOC 2 CCs) — redwood-soc2-evidence-checklist-v1.xlsx (owner: Monica)
- Policies & process docs (infosec policy, incident response, data classification) (owner: Monica)

Karthik — infra deliverables (owner: Karthik):
- Architecture diagram + data flow for the hosted inference path (due 2026-12-08)
- Export of sample logs (last 30 days) and explanation of retention windows incl. token/KV cache behavior (due 2026-12-10)
- KMS/HSM configuration summary and key rotation notes (due 2026-12-10)
- SAML metadata and admin user role list (due 2026-12-10)

Acceptance criteria for initial package:
- All artifacts uploaded to the Drive folder with a one-page README explaining scope and any redactions
- A short internal checklist showing where each artifact maps to the vendor questionnaire

Drive folder (writing now): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfGhIJk_LNK
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

If anything here is unrealistic for the proposed dates, call it out now. Otherwise I'll mark these deliverables in the MAP and send an invite for the 12/7 stakeholder sync (30 min).

Thanks — Monica
